title: GCAII-STD-0001 Conformance Report
description: Machine-readable evidence for a conformance claim against GCAII-STD-0001 v1.0.0. A report describes one tested configuration. It is not a certificate. The schema enforces completeness, not truth: whether the evidence is real is decided on review.

report_version.description: Fixed at 1.0. No reports exist against an earlier published version, so the first release takes 1.0; see versioning.md 4.

spec_version.description: The specification version tested. Prereleases are not valid conformance targets. A report is valid only for the version it names.

capabilities.description: The closed capability set of specification 4.7. Every capability must be declared. A capability not listed here is invalid; adding one requires a minor specification version.

conformance_level.description: L1 declared; L2 harness-verified; L3 independently reviewed; L4 continuous. Levels describe the state of the evidence, not the quality of the implementation.

harness.description: Required at L2 and above. At L1, use assessment instead.

scope_url.description: Where the declaration, its capability block, and the results for every requirement are published.

assessment.description: Required at L1 in place of harness. An L1 claim that is not published is not an L1 claim.

categories.description: The personal-identifier categories the deployment documents, per REQ-5.3.1. Required when processes_personal_data is true. Naming a category here is a declaration that the filter targets it, not that suppression is complete.

model_hash.description: Digest of the model artifact actually loaded, of at least 256 bits.

hash_algorithm.description: The algorithm producing model_hash, named. Any digest of at least 256 bits is acceptable.

results.description: One entry per applicable requirement. not_applicable is neither a pass nor a fail: it requires the capability declaration and the evidence that the capability is absent. minItems is a coverage floor: JSON Schema cannot enforce one entry per requirement, so a 28-entry array that duplicates one requirement and omits another still validates. The traceability table and the review check the rest.

capability.description: Required when status is not_applicable. Names the capability declared false.

evidence.description: An inspectable artifact, not an assertion: a listing, a configuration excerpt, or an observed state.

limitations.description: What this report does not establish. Required at L3 and L4.

independence_statement.description: How the reviewer is independent of the submitting implementation, against the criteria in conformance.md 2.1.

report_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON serialisation of this report with the report_sha256 field removed. A hash cannot cover itself; the excluded-field rule is part of the format, not an implementation choice.

signature.description: Detached signature over the canonical serialisation, in the format named by signature_format.
